event.title: Beginning of WW2
event.description: Germany invades poland using a fast military strategy known as blitzkrieg. Britain and france declared war on Germany soon after which begins World War 2.

event.title: Normandy D-Day Invasion
event.description: Allied forces landed on the beaches of Normandy France opening a major western from against Germany.

event.title: operation barbarossa
event.description: Germany launched a massive invasion on the Soviet Union, which created an eastern front.

event.title: Attack on Pearl Harbor
event.description: Japan attacks a naval base at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii. This attack lead the United States to enter the war.

event.title: Victory in Europe
event.description: Germany surrendered to the allies, officially ending the war in Europe.
